methodological_rigor.justification: RNA-seq comparing parental vs advanced FaDu cells. Gene set enrichment analysis performed. Pathways identified systematically. Limited sample (2 conditions), no biological replicates mentioned. Validation via RT-qPCR on selected genes. Adequate for exploratory genomics.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Cell line-derived transcriptomics. FaDuex xenograft-derived but not human tumor. Relevance to primary hypopharyngeal cancer unclear. No patient sample validation.

reporting_quality.justification: RNA-seq methods briefly described. Sample preparation details sparse. No accession number for raw sequencing data. GSEA methodology not detailed.

novelty_literature.justification: Transcriptomic comparison between parental and advanced cells. Interferon suppression in advanced cancer known. Descriptive without mechanistic innovation.

writing_presentation.justification: Organized results presentation. Discussion lacks depth in mechanistic implications of interferon suppression findings.

key_strengths: Systematic RNA-seq comparison of tumor progression models
GSEA identifies EMT and IFN suppression as key pathways
key_concerns: Limited sample size (parental vs FaDuex only); no biological replicates
FaDuex xenograft-derived, not primary human tumor; generalizability questionable
Interferon suppression in advanced cancers previously documented; limited novelty
No functional validation of pathway predictions
Missing mechanistic link between EMT and IFN suppression
chief_reviewer.rationale: Exploratory transcriptomic study requiring human tissue validation and functional experiments. Tier 4 pending independent cohort confirmation.
